@fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons.reason: Intentional. Icon artwork is CC-BY-4.0 and needs attribution; attributed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons.reason: Intentional. Icon artwork is CC-BY-4.0 and needs attribution; attributed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

caniuse-lite.reason: Build-time browser-support data pulled in by autoprefixer. Never reaches the application.

gsap.reason: Custom GreenSock license rather than MIT. Cockpit uses only the core module, which the standard license covers. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

leaflet.offline.reason: The npm license field does not match the package's own license file, which is LGPL-3.0 and governs. Used unmodified. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

marchingsquares.reason: Reached through @turf/turf, used unmodified and tree-shaken out of the bundle. Its AGPL section 7 additional permission covers unmodified redistribution. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

mavlink2rest-wasm.reason: Developed by Blue Robotics, so not third-party software. The npm metadata carries no license field because the package is built by wasm-pack.

posthog-js.reason: The npm license field carries no SPDX identifier; the package's LICENSE file is the Apache License 2.0.

spdx-exceptions.reason: Build-time SPDX data used by dependency tooling. Never reaches the application.

splaytree-ts.reason: The npm license field misspells the identifier; the package's LICENSE file is the BSD 3-Clause License.

truncate-utf8-bytes.reason: Build-time dependency of electron-builder. Never reaches the application.
